statement: ∀ {S W : Type*} [Field S] [AddCommGroup W] [Module S W] (c : Basis (Reduction.Ind l) S W) (i j k : Reduction.Ind l), Reduction.matrixUnit c i j (c k) = if k = j then c i else 0
proof:
intro S W _ _ _ c i j k
classical
by_cases hk : k = j
· subst k; simp [Reduction.matrixUnit, Basis.coord_apply]
· simp [Reduction.matrixUnit, Basis.coord_apply, hk, Ne.symm hk]
